title: Request only needed fields + exact RV when using FIELD_VALUES search for list pagination
answers: Why does listWithSelectors set Fields and ResultFormat on the search request?
How to get exact (non-approximate) resource version from a search-backed list
Next page token uses wrong/empty sort fields for field-value search results
body: Symptom: list responses backed by the search index could carry an approximate or missing resource version, and continuation tokens need per-row sort fields to resume pagination correctly. Fix pattern: when listing via search, request ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES with Fields: []string{SEARCH_FIELD_RV} so the response returns exact RV metadata plus SortFields per row, then build the next-page token from row.sortFields (not resourceVersion) via NewSearchContinueToken. Constraints: applies to selector-backed list paths that page through search results; don't assume FIELD_VALUES rows carry the full resource table shape — use ResourceSearchRow.GetKey()/GetResourceVersion()/GetSortFields(), distinct from ResourceTableRow.
says: Why does the pagination token lose sort fields between search pages?
How do I get exact resource version from search, not approximate?
List continuation breaks: next page doesn't resume from the correct position
Search-backed lists return incorrect version metadata for pagination token resumption
Why are sort fields missing when you paginate through search results?
search: When listing via search with FIELD_VALUES result format, request Fields: []string{SEARCH_FIELD_RV} to obtain exact resource version metadata plus SortFields per row for correct pagination, since search index responses carry approximate or missing resource versions. Build the next-page continuation token from row.sortFields using NewSearchContinueToken rather than resourceVersion, and access row data via ResourceSearchRow.GetKey()/GetResourceVersion()/GetSortFields() — not ResourceTableRow methods, which assume the full resource table shape. This rule applies only to selector-backed list paths that page through search results (pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go); do not assume FIELD_VALUES rows include all fields from a full resource table.
